propositions: run_pass1 and shed_to_budget lack an injection point for cap_override, forcing ProductionBatchRunner to drop req.usd_budget with a WARNING and use the computed cap instead
plan_budget_cap's centrality-scaling semantics (base * (1.0 + centrality)) make REBAR_PLAN_REVIEW_BUDGET unsuitable as a true cap override
An optional cap_override parameter must thread through ProductionBatchRunner.run -> run_pass1 -> shed_to_budget, defaulting to None to preserve existing behaviour
cap_override must be applied verbatim without centrality scaling, and 0.0 must be honoured as a real cap (not treated as absent)
coverage["budget"] must track cap_source ("override" or "computed") to record which cap governed a run, and budget_override_applied must flip to true when an override is applied
